entries.68b47e4eb5d1fb7e: As a general electrical construction company that developed from railway technology, the company has accumulated core technology and know-how with a high degree of specialization in electrical and communication construction for railways, roads, power transmission lines and various facilities. Building on strong relationships with its major customers, including East Japan Railway Company, and with safety as the foundation of management, the company continues to maintain and improve quality and refine its technology, and it also works on human resource development at its General Training Center.
entries.6908b4621050ae47: Public institutions such as road administrators
entries.88bf93a8b845e996: It provides construction of railway electrical equipment, road equipment, indoor and outdoor electrical equipment and power transmission line equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of signs and traffic safety products.
entries.8c72f2279b0cd02e: Revenue from external customers by segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥70,482 million for the Electrical Equipment Construction Business, ¥3,164 million for Other Business and ¥397 million for the Real Estate Leasing Business, with the Electrical Equipment Construction Business accounting for the bulk of consolidated revenue of ¥74,044 million. Within the Electrical Equipment Construction Business, railway electrical equipment construction is the largest, followed by power transmission line equipment construction, road equipment construction and indoor and outdoor electrical equipment construction. Its major customer is East Japan Railway Company, with revenue of ¥33,510 million, accounting for 45.3% of consolidated revenue. It has no overseas sales.

entries.ad3d8d4f78ae39f5: The company positions its long-term vision, 'NR Vision 2035', as the image it aims for 10 years from now, and as the first step toward it, is promoting its 3-year 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2027', with fiscal 2025 as the first year. Under its group purpose, 'Supporting infrastructure with outstanding technology and sincere construction, and connecting a safe and secure society and a rich way of life to the future,' the company sets as its basic policies safety first, development of the company and society through awareness reform, and employees' sense of purpose in their work. In its business strategy, the company is pursuing improvement and deepening of profitability in existing businesses, diversification, and group company strategy, and it is also working on contributing to productivity improvement through DX and technology development, and to achieving carbon neutrality by 2050 through its environmental strategy 'REACH'.
